origin: Original practice stimulus; reviewed axis/unit derivation

data.unit_rule: Vertical-axis unit divided by horizontal-axis unit; angle/count ratios may be dimensionless.
data.model_limit: Idealised practice data only. Do not infer that every real dataset is exact, that every line passes through the origin, or that the gradient is automatically a familiar constant.

gradient_meaning: For energy vertically against temperature rise, the slope is heat capacity C = mc = 800 J/K. With mass 0.20 kg, c = C/m = 4000 J/(kg K).
aim: find specific heat capacity from energy input and temperature rise of a 0.20 kg sample
arrangement: A 0.20 kg insulated sample with a fitted low-voltage heater, thermometer, balance, voltmeter, ammeter and stopwatch or joulemeter
